<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .

# Shape enforcing that, for any structural member that spans one or more hull areas,
# the selected hull‑area factor must be the largest hull‑area factor among the
# spanned hull areas (I2‑019, clause I2.3.5 (ii)).
nltl:StructuralMemberLargestHullAreaFactorShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:structuralMember ;
    sh:message "The selected hull area factor must equal the maximum hull area factor of all hull areas spanned by the structural member." ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this WHERE {
                # Structural member must have at least one spanned hull area
                $this nltl:hasSpannedHullArea ?area .
                
                # Retrieve the hull‑area factor (QuantityValue) for each spanned area
                ?area nltl:hullAreaFactor ?areaFactor .
                ?areaFactor qudt:numericValue ?areaValue .
                OPTIONAL { ?areaFactor qudt:unit ?areaUnit . }

                # The structural member must have a selected hull‑area factor
                $this nltl:selectedHullAreaFactor ?selectedFactor .
                ?selectedFactor qudt:numericValue ?selectedValue .
                OPTIONAL { ?selectedFactor qudt:unit ?selectedUnit . }

                # Units must be compatible (if present)
                FILTER (
                    (!bound(?areaUnit) && !bound(?selectedUnit)) ||
                    (bound(?areaUnit) && bound(?selectedUnit) && ?areaUnit = ?selectedUnit)
                )

                # Compute the maximum numeric value among all spanned hull‑area factors
                {
                    SELECT (MAX(?v) AS ?maxValue) WHERE {
                        $this nltl:hasSpannedHullArea ?a2 .
                        ?a2 nltl:hullAreaFactor ?f2 .
                        ?f2 qudt:numericValue ?v .
                        OPTIONAL { ?f2 qudt:unit ?u2 . }
                        FILTER ( !bound(?selectedUnit) || !bound(?u2) || ?u2 = ?selectedUnit )
                    }
                }

                # The selected factor must equal that maximum
                FILTER ( ?selectedValue = ?maxValue )
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

# NOTE: The property hullAreaBoundary has unresolved ownership (no explicit owner binding);
# it is therefore not included in the constraint model.
<END_SHACL>
